project_overview: This project involves a web application for managing student data, including enrollment, academic records, and fee payments. The application utilizes a layered architecture with frontend components, backend API services, and a database backend. The primary goal is to provide a streamlined and user-friendly experience for administrators and students alike. Data consistency and security are paramount concerns throughout the application’s design.

layers.description: Handles user interaction, rendering UI components, and communicating with the backend API.
Provides a RESTful API for the frontend to interact with the database.
Responsible for managing the database interactions and data persistence.

macro_trends.title: High Level UI Dependency
macro_trends.description: Several high-level UI components (e.g., examFormView.vue, resultPopup.vue) are deeply nested within other UI components, creating potential for brittle dependencies and difficult maintenance.  This increases the risk of cascading issues if a UI change needs to be made.

macro_trends.title: Inconsistent State Management
macro_trends.description: There may be inconsistent approaches to state management across different components, leading to potential conflicts and difficulties in debugging.

key_workflows.name: Student Enrollment Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves a series of steps, from user authentication and data input to record creation and database updates. It's critical to ensure data integrity and security at each stage.

key_workflows.name: Fee Payment Processing Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow of processing payments must be robust to minimize the impact of the system to any vulnerabilities.
